name: Permanent Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: 4 continuous years of residence on a permit that can serve as a basis for permanent residence.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 4 continuous years of qualifying residence.

requirements.blocker_text: Sufficient funds/income: ISK 259,951/month individual, ISK 415,922/month for a married couple. Exempt for holders of international protection or humanitarian permits.

Must complete a recognised Icelandic-for-foreigners course of at least 150 lessons with 85%+ attendance, or pass an approved language assessment. Exempt if 65+ with 7 years' residency, certified physical/mental inability, or prior education completed in Icelandic.
requirements.fix_path: Complete the 150-lesson Icelandic course or pass the language test.

requirements.blocker_text: No active criminal cases and no pending expulsion proceedings.
3 years of qualifying residence for the spouse of an Icelandic citizen (reduced from the standard 4 years), plus the same income/language/conduct conditions.
2 years of qualifying residence for the child of an Icelandic citizen.

evidence_required.document: Proof of residence period matching the applicable category

sources.title: Island.is -- Permanent Residence Permit: Requirements: 4-year standard (3yr spouse of citizen, 2yr child of citizen, 3yr doctoral graduates, up to 6yr Ukrainian collective protection), ISK income floors, 150-lesson Icelandic course, criminal record clearance

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Iceland). Also confirmed but NOT modeled as separate requirement groups (to avoid excessive fragmentation): doctoral-degree holders (3 years post-completion) and former students (2 years on an eligible permit, 4 years total including study) -- disclosed here. citizenship_after_months (36) uses is_naturalisation.json's Nordic/4-year-adjacent figures as a rough baseline; the precise onward path from PERMANENT residence specifically (as opposed to counting straight from initial residence) was not separately itemised in the source and may overlap with, rather than add to, the naturalisation residence count -- flagged as an approximation.
